name: frameforge
description: Full AI video production engine. Produce short-form reels (1080×1920), YouTube videos (1920×1080), or code-driven animated explainers — directly from your IDE. Playwright + FFmpeg renders every frame. 28 MCP tools. Whisper, yt-dlp, broadcast audio, 24 film styles, ClaudeAnimationBase, onetake 39-move library, HyperFrames motion craft.

skills.name: video-pipeline
skills.description: End-to-end video production: research → script → TTS → images → render → publish. Three paths: (1) IDE writes scenes (most common, no API key), (2) code-driven Playwright animation, (3) auto-research pipeline. 28 MCP tools. Includes Whisper transcription, yt-dlp ingestion, broadcast-grade audio, upstream skills sync.

skills.name: html-renderer
skills.description: HTML-as-compositor rendering: pure seek(t) function, Playwright capture, closed-loop visual QA.

mcpServer.description: Runs the FrameForge MCP server via npx (no install needed). Requires ffmpeg and edge-tts on PATH.

requirements.notes: edge-tts: pip install edge-tts. Playwright (for code-driven animation): npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium (run once in project dir).
